QuestInfo.name: Please Catch the Thief
QuestInfo.0: #p1061005# in #b#m105040300##k has something he wants to say to you. Go see #b#p1061005##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1061005# hears about your work with #p1022007# and asks you to help him. According to him, someone has stolen an expensive herb, and he is sure it is a thief from #m103000000#. He asks that you go to #b#m103000000##k and investigate. You suddenly remember that #bAlex#k is in Kerning City. Perhaps that is a good place to start.

3. #y22536# #b(#u22536#)#k
QuestInfo.2: When you tell #p1061005# that you don't think it was a thief from #m103000000#, he says that he will wait for your investigation for now.

0.0: Ah, are you Evan? I've heard a lot about you. All good things, of course. Speaking of which, I have a mission that only you can complete. Are you interested?
0.1: My job is to collect herbs and make them into medicine. But recently, someone stole one of my herbs! It was a very rare and expensive herb! Do you think you can catch the thief for me?

yes.0: It's doubtful that there are thieves in #m105040300# so I'm certain that a thief from #m103000000# stole it! Can you go to #m103000000# to investigate and bring back my herb?
yes.1: How should go about the investigation? Er, shouldn't you know that? Maybe look around and search for a witness? Try talking to someone you know in #b#m103000000#... I don't know. That's YOUR job!

no.0: Whoa, I didn't expect that. #p1022007# said you were a big-shot hero... Are you done being good and noble already?

1.0: You've returned! So who was the thief? What? You haven't caught the thief yet?

yes.0: It's hard for me to believe that the Thieves in #m103000000# aren't responsible... But since they are willing to put their honor on the line to help find the culprit, I will trust them for now. Now, please find the thief.

quest.0: Have you gone to #m103000000# yet? Until my herb is returned, I don't think I'll even be able to sleep at night. Please go to #b#m103000000# and start your investigation#k.
